name: zclass_typelist_update_queued_trees
description: zClass_TypeList::UpdateQueuedTrees skips already-pending queued links, updates the first active queued tree, and marks it pending removal before rescanning the queue.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass type-list/source-cluster pass.
